short_description: Consumer-facing physical trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal related to body fat mass tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing physical trait with workable raw-array support and a clearer interpretation boundary between inherited body-fat-mass tendency and current measured body composition for the no-imputation workflow.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with body fat mass tendency, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: Body fat mass tendency is presented here as a cautious panel-relative body-composition signal, not as a direct measurement of current body fat percentage, body weight, or health risk. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a deterministic real-world result, a direct body-composition measurement, or health advice.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.

Real-world body fat mass depends strongly on diet, physical activity, age, sex, hormones, illness, medication use, and other non-modeled factors, so this should not be treated as a precise estimate of current body composition.
This trait should be interpreted as a cautious relative body-composition tendency, not as a direct statement about current fitness, appearance, or metabolic health.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
